dialogues.speaker: Claricia
dialogues.text: Ohh, what do I do... I've gone so far over-budget that now I can't get all the paints I really needed...

dialogues.speaker: Xalapa
dialogues.text: Haha. That does happen sometimes, doesn't it?

dialogues.speaker: Xalapa
dialogues.text: When I was younger, I would often travel across Natlan in search of inspiration, and each time, I would discover something unexpected.

dialogues.speaker: Claricia
dialogues.text: Then what would you do if you were in my situation, Granny?

dialogues.speaker: Claricia
dialogues.text: I just wanted to come here and try out different paints, but I wound up buying a whole bunch of new easels, canvases, drawing brushes...

dialogues.speaker: Claricia
dialogues.text: Not only have I not bought any paints yet, but my wallet's already kinda empty...

dialogues.speaker: Xalapa
dialogues.text: Why don't you try earning a bit back through painting commissions?

dialogues.speaker: Xalapa
dialogues.text: Natlan's an ancient land, but other styles of art are always welcome here.

dialogues.speaker: Claricia
dialogues.text: Ooh, that's a great idea! Thanks, Granny, I'll consider it!
